title: Design System: Fr. C.O. Vargis Scholarship Fund

roleTokens.name: --rule-strong
roleTokens.purpose: Rule above a register, slot inset ring.

roleTokens.name: --radius
roleTokens.purpose: One corner for every card and photo container (pinned by the client): prints, slots, doors, status note, lightbox image, Donorbox container. Controls stay at 3px.

roleTokens.name: --rest
roleTokens.purpose: Per-container resting shadow: none on photographs; inset 1px g400 on slots; 1px g300 outer ring on the Donorbox container. Mounting composes over it.

display.purpose: One per page: the leaf title (h1).

headline.purpose: Leaf headings (h2), colophon signature, menu names at their own sizes.

title.purpose: Door titles, gathering entries, degree schools, board member names.

lead.purpose: The line under a display title (40ch); long-form reading bodies.

body.purpose: Running text at 62ch; 500 for links, 600 for strong text and buttons.

label.purpose: Dates, detail lines, hints; tabular figures for dates and prices.

pencil.purpose: Kalam captions, margin notes, menu notes, entry states.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: A photograph before it lands; the lightbox image. There is no resting print shadow: photographs sit flat on the leaf.

shadows.name: door
shadows.purpose: Bookcloth doors lying on the leaf.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Mounting: a photograph settling flat onto the leaf; menu item settle.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State transitions: hover, caption write-on, menu fade.

motion.name: mount
motion.value: translateY(-12px) scale(1.025) with shadow-lifted over --rest, settling to transform none and --rest; transform and box-shadow 1.1s ease-settle, +110ms per index; caption clip-path 1.2s ease-out after +450ms
motion.purpose: The one authored moment, triggered by IntersectionObserver (rootMargin 0 0 -8% 0); static under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Page scrolling; skipped under reduced motion.

textures.name: paper-grain
textures.value: fixed SVG fractal noise, opacity 0.05, multiply

textures.name: weave
textures.value: two SVG fractalNoise layers (0.018 x 0.9 and 0.9 x 0.018)
textures.purpose: Bookcloth on doors, cloth buttons, cloth leaves, notice strip.

accessibility: Focus: 2px solid g900 outline at 3px offset (1px on fields).
g600 only for large text and decoration.
Menu dialog makes all siblings inert; Escape closes; focus returns to trigger.

siteTitle.mobile: clamp(14px, 3.9vw, 26px) below 722px; masthead Donate yields to the menu below 360px

components.css: .ds-door { display: inline-block; vertical-align: top; width: 260px; margin: 0 0.75rem 0.75rem 0; padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 16px; background-color: #212529; color: #f8f9fa; box-shadow: 0 14px 26px -18px rgb(33 37 41 / 0.5); font-family: Mukta, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-door-study { background-color: #495057; } .ds-door-title { margin: 0; font-family: Montserrat, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-door ul { list-style: none; margin: 0.6rem 0 0; padding: 0; } .ds-door a { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 44px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(248 249 250 / 0.18); color: #f8f9fa; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-door li:first-child a { border-top: 0; } .ds-door a span { opacity: 0.7; transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 0.3s; } .ds-door a:hover span { transform: translateX(3px); opacity: 1; } .ds-door a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f8f9fa; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Print
components.description: Unframed photograph with a 16px radius and a level pencil caption; no border, no resting shadow, no rotation. Settles flat when mounted.
components.css: .ds-print { margin: 1rem; width: 200px; } .ds-print-frame { position: relative; display: block; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; background: #dee2e6; isolation: isolate; box-shadow: 0 0 0 transparent; transition: transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-print-img { display: block; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #adb5bd, #495057); } .ds-print:hover .ds-print-frame { transform: translateY(-12px) scale(1.025); box-shadow: 0 34px 46px -22px rgb(33 37 41 / 0.32), 0 8px 14px rgb(33 37 41 / 0.08); } .ds-pencil { display: block; margin-top: 0.85rem; font-family: Kalam, 'Segoe Print', 'Bradley Hand', cursive; font-weight: 300; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.3; color: #495057; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-print-frame { transition: none; } }

components.name: Slot

components.css: .ds-slot { margin: 1rem; width: 180px; } .ds-slot-frame { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; background: #e9ecef; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #ced4da; } .ds-slot-initials { font-family: Kalam, 'Segoe Print', cursive; font-weight: 300; font-size: 2.5rem; color: #6c757d; } .ds-slot-cap { display: block; margin-top: 0.85rem; font-family: Kalam, 'Segoe Print', cursive; font-weight: 300; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #495057; }

narrative.overview:
The site is the parish's own family album. Each page is a light gray leaf; photographs are mounted on it unframed, square to the page with a soft 16px corner, and captioned underneath in pencil. The people Fr. Vargis raised are the proof, so the system's job is to present real photographs with the care of a kept album rather than the gloss of a campaign.

Everything is drawn from nine neutral gray steps; photographs are the only source of color on any page. Depth is physical and quiet: a photograph lands flat on the leaf, bookcloth panels carry a woven texture, and a glassine interleaf lays over the page when the menu opens. Density is generous: wide leaves, a 12-column grid with asymmetric splits, nothing centered by default. One motion moment, mounting, gives the album its life; every other transition is a short state change.

Information that elsewhere would become cards, stat tiles or price boxes is written into the album as ruled register rows: hairline-separated lines of label and text, the way a parish ledger records it.
keyCharacteristics: Nine-step neutral gray palette, nothing else; photographs keep their own color.
Montserrat Bold headings, Mukta text, Kalam pencil captions.
Unframed photographs with a soft 16px corner (client-pinned); an empty slot with initials where a photograph is missing.
Two bookcloth doors (give, study) in g900 and g700 with a woven texture.
Ruled register rows instead of cards.
One authored motion: mounting. Static under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Nine Grays Rule
rules.body: UI color comes only from the nine steps; translucency is allowed only as an alpha of g100 or g900 (glassine, cloth rules, shadows). Anything with a hue belongs to a photograph.

rules.name: The Large-Type Gray Rule
rules.body: g600 holds 3:1 on the leaf, not 4.5:1. It colors display and headline emphasis, 2rem+ initials, and decoration; never body copy, captions or controls.

rules.name: The Neutral Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Where a heading needs emphasis, the phrase steps down to g600 on light leaves and to g400 on cloth. Emphasis is a tonal step, never a hue.

rules.name: The Montserrat Bold Rule
rules.body: Every heading is Montserrat at weight 700 (client-pinned). Montserrat 600 is loaded only for the contact inbox addresses, which are links, not headings.

rules.name: The Pencil Rule
rules.body: Kalam is for writing about a thing (captions, notes, states), never for headings, controls or paragraphs.

rules.name: The Soft Paper Rule
rules.body: All shadows are blurred and negatively spread, cast by paper and cloth on paper. Nothing casts a hard offset block.

rules.name: The Glassine Rule
rules.body: Anything that covers the page (menu, sticky masthead, lightbox backdrop) is translucent and blurred, never an opaque panel.

dos: Do take every UI color from g100 to g900; translucency only as alphas of g100 or g900.
Do set every heading in Montserrat 700.
Do keep g600 to large type and decoration; use g700 or darker for anything at body size.
Do mount photographs unframed, level, with the 16px radius and a pencil caption.
Do keep 16px for cards and photo containers and 3px for controls.
Do use an empty slot with initials where a person has no photograph.
Do write lists of facts, prices and dates as ruled register rows.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44px tall and show the 2px g900 focus outline.
Do make overlays glassine and make the page behind them inert.
Do keep mounting as the only orchestrated motion and make it static under reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce a hue for accents, states or emphasis; emphasis is a tonal step.
Don't use cards, stat tiles, impact counters or priced boxes; write the facts into the register.
Don't put a small tracked label above a heading.
Don't fill a missing photograph with stock, generated or placeholder imagery.
Don't set body copy, captions or controls in g600.
Don't use Kalam for headings, buttons or paragraphs.
Don't use hard offset shadows or opaque overlay panels.
Don't frame photographs: no border, mat, triangular tabs, resting shadow or rotation.
